name: Mio Tachibana
source:
Mio Tachibana is a cheerful, outspoken schoolgirl who announces that she is holding her own funeral on Sunday, despite being perfectly healthy and alive.

She invites three people to attend: Haruto Akiyama, Yuta Moriyama, and Reina Fujimoto. Each has a different relationship with her, and Mio insists that everyone follow a set of rules during the ceremony.

Although she often appears playful and confident, Mio has a tendency to make decisions on behalf of others without asking them first.
